title: Shipping Fees and Delivery Terms — Wound Care Supply Program

# Shipping fees and delivery terms — Wound Care Supply Program

Distribution center tariff for dressing packages shipped on the Wound Care Supply Program.

| Tier | Standard ground shipping fee | Free-shipping threshold | Expedited (two-day) shipping fee | Signature on delivery | Carrier trace period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | USD 6.95 | USD 75.00 | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | No | 3 business days |

## Tariff notes

1. **Standard ground shipping fee** — the fee for standard ground shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold, in USD.
2. **Free-shipping threshold** — the shipment cash-price total, in USD, at or above which standard shipping is free; 0.00 means standard shipping is always free.
3. **Expedited shipping fee** — the fee for customer-requested expedited (two-day) shipping, in USD; it is never billed to a payer.
4. **Signature on delivery** — whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of a dressing package. No tier requires it.
5. **Carrier trace period** — the period, in business days (Monday to Friday excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit.

## Applying the threshold (hypothetical shipments, self-pay tier)

| Shipment cash-price total | Compared with USD 75.00 | Standard shipping |
|---|---|---|
| USD 75.00 | at the threshold | free |
| USD 74.99 | below the threshold | USD 6.95 |
| USD 120.00 | above the threshold | free |
